versions.content: The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyStartOfReception Services from the Rte_LdComCbkStartOfReception callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_RECEIVE [SWS_LDCOM_00049] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
